answer: Sybil resistance comes from a one-per-operator stake: an agent locks capital to earn a single vote, and any identity proven to share an operator with another loses its whole bond. A farmer running a tundra node, a garden market and a cedar relay must post three separate stakes; link any two and all three are slashed. Honest agents pay one stake for one voice, so a thousand fake votes cost a thousand stakes while payout per vote stays flat and the attacker bleeds capital.
